title: Ordinary intrinsic pro-étale direct image: K-injective and bounded-below comparison
statement:
Let $f:X	o Y$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $B$ be a finite commutative ring, including the zero ring. Fix representatives of the small étale and pro-étale sites small in the universe of module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. On each site use intrinsic sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf $B_W$ for $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and their ordinary uncompleted derived categories $D(W_s,B)$, $s\in\{\mathrm{et},\mathrm{proet}\}$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the module direct images induced by $f$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image]. Write $
u_W^*$ for the module comparison inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], with intrinsic constant-section presentation [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-data]. Then both module direct images have total right derived functors $Rf_{s,*}$ on the full ordinary derived categories in the sense of [def-sfb-right-derived-functor]. For every K-injective resolution $M	o I$ their values are canonically $Rf_{s,*}M\cong Q(f_{s,*}I)$, where $Q$ is derived localization. On bounded-below objects these functors identify naturally with the usual bounded-below right derived direct images $Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}:D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)	o D^+(Y_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ and $Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}:D^+(X_{\mathrm{proet}},B)	o D^+(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]; a bounded-below complex of injectives computes both constructions, and the identifications respect their derived-functor units. The intrinsic constant-section module inverse image and the module inverse image $
u_W^*$ are canonically isomorphic as left adjoints to the same sectionwise module direct image $
u_{W,*}$. Under these identifications, for every $G\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},B)$ there is a natural isomorphism in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$
$$
u_Y^*Rf_{\mathrm{et},*}G\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{\mathrm{proet},*}
u_X^*G,$$
which is the bounded-below direct-image comparison isomorphism of [prop-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image] (for $u=f$, $\Lambda=B$, $L=G$) after inclusion into the full derived category. Here $D^+$ means vanishing cohomology in all sufficiently negative degrees [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], and the derived $
u_W^*$ is termwise inverse image followed by localization [lem-pe-coefficient-comparison-derived-functor]. No claim is made for étale inputs with unbounded-below cohomology.
